data.gender_notes: Dp is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words ‘Da’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘P’ meaning ‘grace’. This name signifies the divine blessings and grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods. The name Dp carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dp usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dp belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dp total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: The Dp dynasty was a Hindu dynasty of Jaisalmer in Rajasthan, India, which ruled from the 12th to the 16th century. The Dp rulers were descendants of the Bhatti Rajputs and claimed descent from the Yadava rulers of Devagiri. The most famous ruler of the Dp dynasty was Jait Singh, who was a powerful military general and a supporter of the Delhi Sultanate.
